Two arrested for alleged gangrape of student on Delhi bus

Police have arrested a bus driver and conductor in connection with the alleged gangrape of a 16-year-old student on a sleeper bus traveling between Pari Chowk and Kashmiri Gate in Delhi. The incident reportedly occurred on a bus traveling from Mainpuri to Kashmiri Gate via Greater Noida. The bus, which allegedly traveled for 47 kilometers with the student inside, has been sent for forensic examination.
